data.name: Maulud
data.gender_notes: Maulud is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Name of the prophet Muhammad's birthday. The name Maulud carries the meaning “Birth or birthday” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maulud usually hope their child will grow to embody birth or birthday and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Celebrating the birth of the prophet
data.etymology: Maulud belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Birth or birthday.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maulud total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: مولود
in_arabic.meaning: المولود هو الشخص الذي ولد حديثا
in_arabic.long_meaning: مولود هو اسم مشتق من الفعل ولد، ويعني الشخص الذي ولد حديثا، ويدل على البداية الجديدة للحياة، وفي القرآن الكريم يقول الله تعالى: "وَلَقَدْ جَاءَكُم مِّن عِندِنَا رَسُولٌ مُحَمَّدٌ مَوْلُودٌ مِنَ الأُمِّيَّةِ"، ويحمل هذا الاسم دلالات روحية عميقة تتعلق بالخلق والبداية.

in_urdu.name: مولود
in_urdu.meaning: مولود کا مطلب ہے نومولود بچہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: مولود ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے نومولود بچہ، جو ابھی دنیا میں آیا ہے۔ یہ نام ولادت کی خوشیاں اور نئی زندگی کی شروعات کا اظہار کرتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان اس نام کا خاص اہمیت ہے، جہاں یہ نومولود بچوں کو دیا جاتا ہے تاکہ ان کی زندگی مبارک ہو۔

in_hindi.name: मौलूद
in_hindi.meaning: मौलूद का अर्थ है नवजात शिशु
in_hindi.long_meaning: मौलूद एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है नवजात शिशु। यह नाम नई ज़िंदगी की शुरुआत और जन्म की खुशियों को दर्शाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम अक्सर नवजात शिशुओं को दिया जाता है ताकि उनकी ज़िंदगी आशीर्वादित हो।

in_pashto.name: مولود
in_pashto.meaning: مولود د نوي زېږېدلي ماشوم معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: مولود د عربي نوم دی چې د نوي زېږېدلي ماشوم معنی يې ده. دا نوم د ژوند د پيل او نوي راتلو لپاره کارول کېږي. په افغانستان او پښتونستان کې، دا نوم د نوي زېږېدلي ماشومانو لپاره کارول کېږي ترڅو د هغوی ژوند برکت لرونکی وي.

in_english.name: Maulud
in_english.long_meaning: Maulud is an Arabic name derived from the root 'wl-d', meaning 'to give birth' or 'newborn child'. It signifies a new beginning in life. In Islamic tradition, the name Maulud is associated with the Prophet Muhammad's birthday, celebrated as Mawlid al-Nabi. The name carries spiritual significance, symbolizing the joy and blessings of new life.

data.cultural_impact: Maulud is a significant cultural event in the Islamic world, celebrated annually in honor of the birth of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The celebration is marked by various rituals, including recitation of the Quran, narration of hadiths (prophetic teachings), and special prayers.
data.spiritual_significance: The observance of Maulud is regarded as an opportunity to remind ourselves of the life and teachings of the Prophet (pbuh). It serves as a reminder of his mercy, compassion, and guidance, and inspires us to live our lives in accordance with his teachings and standards. By celebrating his birthday, Muslims express their love, devotion, and appreciation for the Prophet (pbuh), who brought them the message of God and is their greatest role model.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Birth or birthday" symbolizes Name of the prophet Muhammad's birthday. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Maulud serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of birth or birthday.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Maulud is mentioned in the Hadith as a name of the Prophet Muhammad The name Maulud carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Maulud is associated with the Islamic tradition of celebrating the birth of the Prophet Muhammad

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Maulud remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
